note: Image → video with sound, on your GPU. Video keeps your photo's shape; pick size in megapixels. Faster: ⚡ Fast mode, 16 FPS, 5 s, 0.2–0.4 MP.

fields.label: FPS (smoothness)
fields.help: Frames = seconds × FPS. 16 = faster, 24 = smoother motion.

fields.label: Video size (megapixels)
fields.help: Shape follows the photo automatically. 0.2 ≈ 448×448 · 0.4 ≈ 640×640 · 0.9 ≈ 960×960. Bigger = sharper but slower.

fields.label: ⚡ Fast mode (turbo LoRA, 8 steps)
fields.help: Much faster, slightly lower motion/audio quality

fields.label: Video model
fields.help: int8_convrot (19.5 GB) recommended on 31 GB RAM · bf16 (37.5 GB) is very slow here · w4a8 (11.7 GB) smallest

fields.label: Load as
fields.help: Leave default for int8 / w4a8 files

fields.label: Text encoder
fields.help: nvfp4_awq (~18 GB) is best on RTX 50 · int8_convrot is 25 GB

templates.name: Fast action (3 s)
templates.help: Best with Duration 3 + FPS 24 (= exactly 3 s). One quick action only.
templates.text:
The subject from <Picture 1>, same look and same scene. Fast-paced, real-time speed, no slow motion.
SHOT 1: Immediately from the first frame, {prompt}, in one quick, energetic motion, finishing by the end of the clip. Dynamic handheld camera that follows the movement, sharp and snappy.
Audio: natural, crisp sounds that match the action, with a quick whoosh on the movement.

templates.name: Person / talking
templates.help: Keeps face, outfit and scene. Describe what they do or say.

templates.name: Cinematic
templates.help: Smooth, filmic movement. Good for 5 s.

templates.name: Product ad
templates.text:
Editorial product film. The product from <Picture 1> with its exact original design, premium studio lighting, dark background with soft reflections.
SHOT 1: {prompt}, with a deliberate camera push-in that reveals the details.
Audio: deep subtle bass room tone, crisp tactile clicks and a soft whoosh.

promptBoost.label: ✨ Realism boost (real face, body, skin & motion)
promptBoost.help: Adds identity, natural body, real skin and realistic-motion instructions to every video prompt. Turn off for cartoon/stylized videos.
promptBoost.text: Keep the person or subject from <Picture 1> exactly the same throughout: same face and recognizable identity, facial proportions, hair, skin tone, natural body shape and proportions, and outfit. Natural, unretouched skin with real texture, not plastic or airbrushed. Realistic, natural motion with real-world physics and believable weight; stable face and body with no morphing, warping, melting or flicker; correct hands and fingers. Lighting and colors consistent with the first frame. Photorealistic, like real camera footage.

presets.name: ⚡ Fastest
presets.help: Turbo v1.2 LoRA at 4 steps, 0.3 MP, 16 FPS. Quick previews and testing prompts. Needs the 4-step v1.2 LoRA (download script).

presets.name: ⚖ Balanced
presets.help: Turbo 4-step v1.2 at 0.45 MP, 24 FPS. Good everyday quality and speed on a 12 GB card.

presets.name: 💎 Best quality
presets.help: No turbo, 20 full steps, 0.6 MP, 24 FPS. Best motion and audio, several times slower.
